description: The shape of a deployment's never-touch list, with placeholders. The real one
is gs://<state-bucket>/config/<env>/deny-list.json, written by the owner and
read by deny_list_load in scripts/lib/common.sh; this repository holds none.
project: the deployment's PROJECT_ID; a list written for another project refuses.
entries: every resource in the project that belongs to someone else.
classify: optional {glob, kind} rules for this deployment's names, read ahead of
the generic ones in destroy-guard-proof-cases.json (`*` is the only wildcard).
floors: the fewest entries of each kind (`total` for all) the list may hold; a
list below any floor refuses, so a truncated list cannot pass for a short one.
A project that shares nothing writes "entries": [] with every floor 0, and
says who reviewed that and when: an empty list is a statement, never a default.
